title: play_action_event
description: The active player plays an action event from hand during an action window and pays its cost (`card_cost`); the event goes to the discard pile. The player resolves its effects with other actions, then ends their opportunity to act (`end_opportunity`). Interrupt and reaction events are played with `play_interrupt_event` and `play_reaction_event`.

card_id.description: Action event in the hand of the player.
